notes: No testAddCouplingConstraint.m existed; testConstraintModifciation.m (calls it among addCOBRAConstraints, addRatioReaction, constrainRxnListAboveBound, addCouplingConstraint, removeCOBRAConstraints, removeRxns, addReaction) and testLegacy/testModelManipulationOri.m test it among other functions, none alone, so a new file in the quarantine layout was written (folder testMultiSpeciesModelling holds testCoupleRxnList2Rxn, the other src/analysis/coupling test). The body is the one-line wrapper addCOBRAConstraints(model, rxnList, d, 'c', c, 'dsense', ineqSense), identical to constrainRxnListAboveBound. Severity follows earlier precedents ('optional input without default cannot be omitted' graded error: write4ti2 uni, lrsReadRay/lrsWriteHalfspace param, sampleScatterMatrix); LEAD DECISION if graded cosmetic/limitation instead: the function would be TESTED (both behaviours are easy to pin with the probe below). The k x 1 failure lies partly in addCOBRAConstraints too: its validator (line 137) accepts a column c of length numel(idList) that line 230 then cannot index (not checkDuplicates related; reported for the lead). No call passes checkDuplicates, so the addCOBRAConstraints quarantine is not reached. Quarantine reach: confined to call forms with fewer than 5 inputs or a column c; grep finds no src/ caller of the function (2026-11-23), so it blocks nothing. Reproduction (MATLAB): model = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'R1','R2','R3'}, {'A -> B','B -> C','C -> '}, 'printLevel', 0); addCouplingConstraint(model, {'R1','R2'}) -> 'Not enough input arguments.' (line 35); addCouplingConstraint(model, {'R1','R2'}, [1 1], 6) -> same; addCouplingConstraint(model, {'R1','R2'}, [1; 2], 6, 'G') -> index error at addCOBRAConstraints:230; addCouplingConstraint(model, {'R1','R2'}, [1 2], 6, 'G') -> full(C) = [1 2 0], d = 6, dsense 'G', ctrs {'Constraint1'}.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: c, d and ineqSense are documented as optional but used at line 35 without defaults; a k x 1 c also reaches the column-c defect of addCOBRAConstraints, lines 137 and 230)

notes: No testApplyEFluxConstraints.m existed; testEFlux.m tests eFlux (which calls it) and needs the internet, so a new quarantine-layout file was written in testEFlux. Model for all reproductions (MATLAB): model = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'R1','R2','R3'}, {'A <=> B','B -> C','C -> '}, 'printLevel', 0, 'grRuleList', {'g1','g2 or g3','g1 and g2'}); then the three triggers. The working path, for reference: preprocessed false, values g1=2, g2=4, g3=1, minSum default true -> R1 2, R2 5 (OR = sum), R3 2 (AND = min), max 5 -> lb [-0.4; 0; 0], ub [0.4; 1; 0.4] (hand-derived, matches the probe). Calls to addCOBRAConstraints (lines 115, 117) never pass checkDuplicates, so the addCOBRAConstraints quarantine is not reached; its callees addCOBRAVariables and mapExpressionToReactions behaved as expected in the probe. LEAD DECISION - quarantine reach: eFlux (src/dataIntegration/transcriptomics/eFlux/eFlux.m lines 115, 120, 135) passes the user's expression structs through; the line-82 error is reached whenever preprocessed is true or absent (eFlux itself sets controlExpression.preprocessed = true when absent), the softBounds defect whenever 'softBounds' true is passed: not recognisable in eFlux's code, so eFlux reaches both (eFlux already has the legacy testEFlux.m, which uses preprocessed false and asserts softBounds results equal to hard ones, consistent with the forward-bound defect). Also noted: the help documents minSum default true while eFlux documents and passes its own default false (consistent with each header).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 82 assigns expression.target (names) into the numeric reactionExpression where expression.value is meant, so every call with preprocessed true stops; writer's MATLAB reproductions of the default and softBounds defects; eFlux, which has the legacy testEFlux and calls it with preprocessed true when absent, is outside the ledger)
